title: Strict route matching keeps public pages reachable beside the wizard closer

source.ref: Installed Next16.4 route normalizer and built runtime

detail: The wizard catchall participates in sibling route matches without a main children fallback, leaving85 pages incomplete under Next16.4 strict matching. An implicit children default preserves the wizard closer while making every page complete. Actual bundled normalizer test passes; built homepage/feed return200 and a new arbitrary URL404. Existing explicit catchall not-found segment remains intact. Backlog verification now executes fast, read-only consequences without launching a nested test runner. The full behavioral suites remain independently enforced by required CI; source guard, missing/incorrect behavior and deliberately broken controls fail rather than being waived.
